text:
eliot: Heads-up — getting a noisy spike of kv-store read_timeouts in prod starting ~07:40 UTC. Seems correlated with a large customer load test. The alert firing is `KVReadTimeoutHigh` and it's noisy right now. Can we discuss a short quiet window or threshold tweak?

sre-bot: Alert KVReadTimeoutHigh currently:
```
alert: KVReadTimeoutHigh
expr: sum(rate(kv_read_timeouts_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_requests_total[5m])) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/kv-read-timeouts
```

rachael: Can you paste the dashboard panel link and attach a small graph? curious if this is a sustained increase or short bursts. Also, is there a request tag we can use to suppress (e.g. loadtest=true)?

eliot: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv/cache-health?orgId=1&panelId=7. Quick screenshot: p95 latencies are elevated but p99 is stable — looks like short tail timeouts. We don't have a consistent loadtest flag on these customers.

jamie: Two options: 1) temporarily mute the alert for an hour and add a note in the incident log, or 2) raise the threshold from 2% -> 3% and increase `for` from 5m -> 10m so only sustained issues page. I'm leaning to short mute during the controlled load test window.

sam: Agreed on 1h mute. Proposed mute window: start now (1718001234) until +3600s (1718004834). Also can add a suppression rule for requests with header `x-internal-loadtest: true` if we can get the customer to set it next time.

rachael: If we mute, please also create a one-line follow-up task to revert or re-evaluate the alert after the test. Don't want this to become permanent without review.

eliot: Will do. Proposed mute API call (obs API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://observability.redwood.internal/api/v1/mutes \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OBS_TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"alert":"KVReadTimeoutHigh","until":1718004834,"metadata":{"reason":"customer load test","owner":"eng-sre"}}'
```

jamie: +1 to that. Can you also add the grafana snapshot link and set a reminder in 1h to validate? :clock1: :thumbsup:

eliot: Snapshot added and reminder set. I'll also open a tiny PR to change the alert rule to 3%/10m if we see repeat noise after the test.

rachael: Thanks. If anything flips to actual degradation (increased errors or p99 jumps), unmute and alert as usual.

sam: A few follow-ups for post-mute: 1) check the `kv_errors_total` spike correlation, 2) consider adding a `source` label to requests from large tenants for future suppression.

eliot: noted, thanks all. Muting now and logging the action. :white_check_mark:
